run_rename_images_cli: run the rename_images script with --dry-run to preview filename changes in a directory of camera images
run_add_dirname_prefix: run the rename_images script with --prefix to add each camera directory name as a filename prefix
run_remove_dirname_prefix: run the rename_images script with --remove-prefix to strip the directory name prefix from image filenames
run_renumber_photos: run the rename_images script with --renumber to sequentially renumber all images in subdirectories starting from 1
run_consecutive_photos: run the rename_images script with --consecutive to fix Sony SDK duplicate filenames like _DSC0001(1).ARW
